notes: Placeholder skins are procedurally generated and are NOT the real creators' skins.

To use a real skin: place a Minecraft-compatible 64x64 (or 64x32 / HD) PNG at assets/skins/<id>.png (or user://skins/<id>.png at runtime) and update this manifest's source/license fields. Supplied files are never overwritten by tools/gen_assets.py.
No Mojang/Minecraft game assets are included. Block textures, item models, character geometry and all audio are original, generated by tools/gen_assets.py and tools/gen_audio.py.
